requests.title: Test deploy key: amend the credential rule for the deployed test build
requests.question: The owner added four Actions secrets (REPO_OWNER, DATA_SOURCE, CAUSA_BRANCH, DATA_ACCESS_KEY_CAUSA) so the deployed app (deploy-pages.yml) reaches the live test data repository by itself. EXT-DATA-004-O1 ('Credentials MUST never be committed, bundled, logged, ...') and DF-CON-2026-A002's bootstrap criterion ('no credential ... is committed, bundled into the client ... A CI check fails the build when one appears') forbid it. Amend them, for the competition build against v4.1.6, with the minimum exception, the amended wording, the added obligation EXT-DATA-004-O5 and its tests, and the changed CI check that docs/v416-competition-decisions/TEST-DEPLOY-KEY.md states (pinned)?
options: A: approve the exception exactly as TEST-DEPLOY-KEY.md states it (sections 2, 4 and 5)
B: keep the prohibition; the key is entered per session in the Connect form
requests.recommendation: A: the owner's direction (a test, no secret data, access acceptable; amend rather than avoid bundling). The owner stated this in session; that statement is not a record. This request is how it is recorded.
requests.rationale: Changes a P0 security requirement and a Conditor baseline decision; only the owner amends requirements (RDP-003), and frozen packages are never edited.
requests.impact: A: an agent applies the amended text, EXT-DATA-004-O5 and its tests to the v4.1.6 candidate after claude/v4.1.6-review-fixes merges (or to its successor), the competing build's integration lane adds the deploy connection and the scan step to its Conditor-generated deploy-pages.yml (reference: indy-init-rehearsal-010 branch setup/test-deploy-key), and the owner adds the four secrets with the App secrets before T0 (with P-7). The key in the public site is readable by anyone until revoked. B: nothing changes; the four secrets stay unused and DATA_ACCESS_KEY_CAUSA should be deleted.
requests.exception: Only the one key of the secret DATA_ACCESS_KEY_CAUSA; only for the designated test data repository REPO_OWNER/DATA_SOURCE on branch CAUSA_BRANCH; only in the deployed test build (the build step of .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml, CAUSA_DEPLOY_CONNECTION=1); only in dist/deploy-connection.json of the deploy artifact. Never committed, never logged, never in events, reports, Praxis state, URLs, error text, localStorage or any browser store. Least privilege: a fine-grained token on that one repository with Contents read and write (Metadata read, added by GitHub) and nothing else, short expiry, revocable. The deployed site is public: anyone can extract the key and read and write that repository until it is revoked; this is the accepted risk.
requests.ciCheck: The DF-CON-2026-A002 CI check changes from 'fails when a credential appears' to: fails on any credential except exactly the injected DATA_ACCESS_KEY_CAUSA value in the deploy artifact's deploy-connection.json, and on that value anywhere else (source scan EXT-DATA-004-O1 unchanged; build scan in every build; an independent scan step in deploy-pages.yml before upload). Findings name the file, never the value.
dependsOn: claude/v4.1.6-review-fixes (in flight on v4.1.6; P13 is applied after it merges, not on it)
